name: Encrafted
description:
About This Game

Encrafted is ridiculously easy to pick up, but a thrill to master.

The goal is simple: Sell materials to gain enough money to pass a round's goal.

Your Bag is like a deck of cards, draw from the bag to get a random assortment of materials from it. Buy, destroy, and apply spells to materials every round to tweak and cultivate the bag to your liking.

Combine up to 4 materials in the crafting slots to merge them into a vast array of other materials.

Along the way collect distinct Artefacts that have powerful effects which have the possibility of synergising with one another, creating deadly combinations and addictively-satisfying results.

Features:

  • 5 different bags to play with, each with their own rules and starting materials.

  • 250+ unique Artefacts that bring with them their own potential to massively increase the value of your sales.

  • 200+ Material types to discover, craft with, and sell.

  • 20 spells to come across and apply to your Materials or Artefacts during your runs.

  • 17 upgrade types that you can purchase between rounds to increase any of your stats permanently for the run.

  • 10 difficulty levels for each bag that add compounding challenges if you're up for it.

  • All code and art is done by just me (human-made)! :)

During every run, discover more ways to build money, and unlock new Artefacts that will show up randomly in future attempts.
short_desc: Collect, refine, and craft with a vast array of materials, cashing out your most valuable creations to pass ever-rising profit goals! Leverage and synergise countless Artefacts, upgrades, and spells to become increasingly powerful in the addictive roguelike deckbuilding game Encrafted!
